examples.name: Default
examples.summary: The band spans the window; its copy stays on the page’s measure.
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import Hero from '@aziontech/webkit/hero'
</script>

<template>
  <Hero max-width="7xl">
    <Hero.Title
      centered
      eyebrow="Infrastructure"
      eyebrow-prefix="//"
      title="A global network built for fast applications"
      description="Run closer to users with low-latency delivery and stable routing."
    />
  </Hero>
</template>

examples.name: Widths
examples.summary: Three caps in one view — a width only reads against another.

examples.name: Screen
examples.summary: With `kind="screen"` the band measures one viewport, minus whatever `--banner-offset` a sticky bar above it declares.
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import Hero from '@aziontech/webkit/hero'
</script>

<template>
  <Hero
    kind="screen"
    max-width="site"
  >
    <Hero.Title
      centered
      eyebrow="Infrastructure"
      eyebrow-prefix="//"
      title="A global network built for fast applications"
    />
  </Hero>
</template>
